name: generic_linux
description: Metrics for Linux hosts running Net-SNMP (snmpd). Coverage depends entirely on snmpd configuration — a minimal default config exposes only MIB-II system/interfaces and hrSystem scalars. A fully configured snmpd additionally exposes UCD-SNMP-MIB (memory, load averages, CPU raw counters) and the full HOST-RESOURCES-MIB (storage, per-CPU load). Both profile groups are included here; OIDs that are not configured in snmpd will simply return no data.
